entries.en: The lecture used stained tissue images to illustrate demyelination.
entries.zh: 讲座用染色组织图像说明了脱髓鞘作用。

entries.en: The private school offers scholarships funded by former pupils.
entries.zh: 这所私立学校提供由校友资助的奖学金。

entries.en: After his father's death, the coach became a father figure to him.
entries.zh: 父亲去世后，教练成了他心目中父亲般的人。

entries.en: Researchers searched the on-line database for earlier records of the comet.
entries.zh: 研究者在联机数据库中搜索这颗彗星的早期记录。

entries.en: The villagers in the tale blamed the storm on black art.
entries.zh: 故事中的村民把风暴归咎于妖术。

entries.en: The workshop became, as it were, a second home for the apprentices.
entries.zh: 这间作坊可以说成了学徒们的第二个家。

entries.en: The novel's marriage of convenience united two rival trading families.
entries.zh: 小说中那桩利益婚姻把两个敌对的商人家族联结在了一起。

entries.en: The crate's label gives the fruit's place of origin.
entries.zh: 板条箱的标签注明了水果的原产地。

entries.meaningZh: 欺诈（含冒犯意味的俚语，不建议使用）
entries.en: The dealer gypped tourists by charging for repairs he never performed.
entries.zh: 商贩收取根本没有进行的维修费用，欺骗游客。

entries.en: The herbalist strained the tisane into a small ceramic cup.
entries.zh: 草药师把草药饮液滤进了一只小陶杯。

entries.en: The medical student noted odynophagia among the patient's reported symptoms.
entries.zh: 医学生在患者自述症状中记下了吞咽痛。

entries.en: The visiting scholars took their places at the high table.
entries.zh: 来访学者在贵宾桌旁就座。

entries.en: The story's bad person steals the villagers' winter supplies.
entries.zh: 故事里的坏人偷走了村民的过冬物资。

entries.en: The proposal was under attack from both sides of the debate.
entries.zh: 辩论双方都在抨击这项提案。

entries.en: She pulled a book at random from the crowded shelf.
entries.zh: 她从挤满书的架子上随手抽出一本。

entries.en: In the dark, he groped for the switch beside the door.
entries.zh: 黑暗中，他摸索着寻找门旁的开关。

entries.en: The local area network connects the printers in all three offices.
entries.zh: 局域网连接着三个办公室里的打印机。

entries.en: A hue and cry arose when the council proposed closing the pool.
entries.zh: 议会提议关闭游泳池时，响起了一片抗议声。

entries.en: The chemistry seminar examined pleomorphism through crystals of the same compound.
entries.zh: 化学研讨课通过同一化合物的晶体考察了同质多晶现象。

entries.en: The model places a smaller epicycle on the rim of the larger circle.
entries.zh: 模型把一个较小的本轮放在大圆的边缘上。

entries.en: Her semiology essay analyzes the symbols used in railway signs.
entries.zh: 她的符号学论文分析了铁路标志中使用的符号。

entries.en: The treaty's open-door policy promised equal trading opportunities to foreign merchants.
entries.zh: 条约的门户开放政策承诺向外国商人提供平等的贸易机会。

entries.en: The seminar debated which party carried the burden of proof.
entries.zh: 研讨课讨论了哪一方承担举证责任。

entries.en: Water began to flow out through the cracked pipe.
entries.zh: 水开始从破裂的管道流出。

entries.en: The defenders waited behind the line of scrimmage for the snap.
entries.zh: 防守球员在争球线后等待开球。

entries.en: The department head approved the request for new microscopes.
entries.zh: 部门主任批准了购置新显微镜的申请。

entries.en: The photographer studied the beetle at close range.
entries.zh: 摄影师近距离观察了那只甲虫。

entries.en: She wrote a tanka about the moon above the harbor.
entries.zh: 她写了一首关于港口上方月亮的短歌。

entries.en: The visiting lecturer discussed the history of neuropsychiatry.
entries.zh: 来访讲师讨论了神经精神病学的历史。

entries.en: The final line is metrically irregular but effective when spoken aloud.
entries.zh: 最后一行在格律上不规则，但朗读起来效果很好。

entries.en: The first quarter moon shone above the rooftops on a cloudless evening.
entries.zh: 无云的夜晚，上弦月在屋顶上方照耀。

entries.en: The informal agreement left a grey area over who would pay for repairs.
entries.zh: 这份非正式协议对谁支付维修费留下了模糊地带。

entries.en: The winning team completed a lap of honour with the trophy.
entries.zh: 获胜球队捧着奖杯绕场一周，接受欢呼。

entries.en: The film turns an old village legend into a love story.
entries.zh: 电影把一个古老的村庄传说改编成了爱情故事。

entries.en: The defender's own goal gave the visiting team an unexpected lead.
entries.zh: 防守球员的乌龙球让客队意外领先。

entries.en: In the novel, the rivals meet on the field of honor at dawn.
entries.zh: 小说中，两位对手黎明时在决斗场见面。

entries.en: The school board voted to repair the damaged playground.
entries.zh: 教育委员会投票决定修缮受损的操场。

entries.en: The historian examined remilitarization through records of reopened army bases.
entries.zh: 历史学家通过重新开放的军事基地记录考察了重新武装的过程。

entries.en: A stone gryphon guarded each side of the castle gate.
entries.zh: 城堡大门两侧各有一尊狮鹫石像守护。

entries.en: The philosopher defended the immateriality of thought against a physical account.
entries.zh: 哲学家为思想的非物质性辩护，反对将其完全作物理解释。

entries.en: The editor cannot save changes to a read-only file.
entries.zh: 编辑器无法把改动保存到只读文件中。

entries.en: The architect will confer with the builders before revising the plan.
entries.zh: 建筑师修改方案前会和施工人员商谈。

entries.en: The law course contrasts public law with rules governing private agreements.
entries.zh: 法律课程把公法与管理私人协议的规则作了比较。

entries.en: Our departure is contingent on the bridge reopening.
entries.zh: 我们能否出发取决于大桥能否重新开放。

entries.en: Market research showed that customers preferred smaller refillable bottles.
entries.zh: 市场调查显示，顾客更喜欢较小的可补充装瓶子。

entries.en: The museum displayed early paper money beside metal coins.
entries.zh: 博物馆把早期纸币和金属硬币并列展出。

entries.meaningZh: 成为关系相当确定的情侣
entries.en: They began to go steady after meeting at college.
entries.zh: 他们在大学相识后，开始稳定交往。

entries.en: The ledger records an impost charged on imported cloth.
entries.zh: 账簿记载了对进口布料征收的关税。

entries.en: The chemistry student located mannitol in the laboratory inventory.
entries.zh: 化学学生在实验室库存清单中找到了甘露糖醇。

entries.en: A lurker behind the curtain watched the guards leave.
entries.zh: 一个潜伏在帘后的人看着卫兵离开。

entries.en: The genetics paper examines a position effect after moving the gene.
entries.zh: 遗传学论文考察了移动该基因后的位点效应。

entries.en: She did not shy away from asking the difficult question.
entries.zh: 她没有回避提出那个棘手的问题。

entries.en: The library's annual social event brings volunteers together for dinner.
entries.zh: 图书馆每年的联谊活动让志愿者聚在一起吃晚饭。

entries.en: His big sister helped him build the model bridge.
entries.zh: 他的姐姐帮他搭建了桥梁模型。

entries.en: He attended summer school to improve his written French.
entries.zh: 他上了暑期补习班，提高法语写作水平。

entries.en: Please clear away the empty cups before the next session.
entries.zh: 请在下一场开始前收走空杯子。

entries.en: The designer used a small capital for the opening letter.
entries.zh: 设计师把首字母设成了小型大写字母。

entries.en: He answered the early knock in dishabille, still wearing his nightshirt.
entries.zh: 清早有人敲门时，他还穿着睡衣，衣着随便地应了门。

entries.en: The baker tucked a small biscuit into my bag as lagniappe.
entries.zh: 面包师在我的袋子里塞了一块小饼干作为赠品。

entries.en: The editorial condemned demagogy that exploited voters' fears of outsiders.
entries.zh: 社论谴责了利用选民排外恐惧的蛊惑宣传。

entries.en: He sent a night letter so the message would arrive the next morning.
entries.zh: 他发了一封夜间电报，让消息在第二天早晨送达。

entries.en: In the film, the gunner let fly as the enemy ship approached.
entries.zh: 影片中，敌船接近时，炮手开了火。

entries.en: The data system links communications between the warehouse and the sales office.
entries.zh: 资料系统把仓库与销售办公室之间的通信连接起来。

entries.en: The staff accepted a temporary pay cut to keep the workshop open.
entries.zh: 员工接受暂时减薪，以维持车间运转。

entries.en: The court report describes an assault and battery charge after the fight.
entries.zh: 法院报道描述了打斗后提出的一项殴打罪指控。

entries.en: That old inventor is still knocking about and repairing clocks.
entries.zh: 那位老发明家还健在，仍在修钟。

entries.en: The family placed the urn in a niche in the columbarium.
entries.zh: 家人把骨灰瓮安放在骨灰堂的壁龛里。

entries.en: The exhibition includes biographic notes beside each artist's portrait.
entries.zh: 展览在每位艺术家的肖像旁配有生平简介。

entries.en: A worn detent allowed the wheel to turn backward.
entries.zh: 磨损的棘爪使轮子能够倒转。

entries.en: She tacked on a short explanation at the end of the report.
entries.zh: 她在报告末尾加了一段简短说明。

entries.en: The family was bombed out during the raid and slept at the station.
entries.zh: 这家人的住所空袭时被炸毁，他们便在车站过夜。

entries.en: The designer chose a type family with matching regular and italic styles.
entries.zh: 设计师选了一个具有配套正体和斜体的字体家族。

entries.en: We traveled second class to save money for the longer journey.
entries.zh: 我们乘二等座，把钱省下来用于更长的旅程。

entries.en: The council cast out the member who had stolen its funds.
entries.zh: 理事会驱逐了那个盗用其资金的成员。

entries.en: The lesson compares our system of numeration with Roman numerals.
entries.zh: 课程把我们的记数法与罗马数字作了比较。

entries.en: The little girl carried a red umbrella through the rain.
entries.zh: 小女孩撑着一把红伞走在雨中。

entries.en: The inquiry described the deliberate destruction of records as condemnable.
entries.zh: 调查认定，蓄意销毁记录的行为应受谴责。

entries.en: The watercolourist waited for the paper to dry before adding shadows.
entries.zh: 水彩画家等纸干了，再添上阴影。

entries.en: He indiscreetly mentioned the surprise party within earshot of its guest.
entries.zh: 他轻率地提起惊喜派对，让派对主宾听到了。

entries.en: Mark the centre of curvature before drawing the mirror's principal axis.
entries.zh: 画镜面的主轴前，先标出曲率中心。

entries.en: The appraiser estimated the painting's market value before the auction.
entries.zh: 估价师在拍卖前估算了这幅画的市场价值。

entries.en: The social club meets monthly for walks and shared meals.
entries.zh: 联谊会每月聚会，组织散步和聚餐。

entries.en: The defenders fought off the attack until reinforcements arrived.
entries.zh: 防守者击退进攻，一直坚持到援军到达。

entries.en: The buoy moved up and down with each passing wave.
entries.zh: 每当波浪经过，浮标就上下起伏。

entries.en: The chamber of commerce organized a fair for local manufacturers.
entries.zh: 商会为当地制造商举办了一场展销会。

entries.en: He arrived thoroughly pixilated and could barely find his chair.
entries.zh: 他到场时酩酊大醉，几乎找不到自己的椅子。

entries.en: The student traced the pinna on the model of the human ear.
entries.zh: 学生沿着人耳模型的耳廓描了一圈。

entries.en: We checked the time zone before scheduling the international call.
entries.zh: 安排国际通话前，我们核对了时区。

entries.en: A fireworks display topped off the evening's celebrations.
entries.zh: 一场烟花表演结束了晚上的庆祝活动。

entries.en: The new copier finished the large print job very fast.
entries.zh: 新复印机很快完成了这批大量的打印任务。

entries.en: She agreed to take on responsibility for the volunteer schedule.
entries.zh: 她同意承担安排志愿者日程的责任。

entries.en: That document may bear on the question of who owned the land.
entries.zh: 那份文件可能与土地归谁所有的问题有关。

entries.en: We counted on dry weather when choosing the outdoor stage.
entries.zh: 选择户外舞台时，我们指望天气干燥。

entries.en: An accidental spoonerism made the announcer stop and repeat the names.
entries.zh: 播音员意外把首音互换了，只好停下来重念名字。

entries.en: The anatomy model shows the levator lifting the upper eyelid.
entries.zh: 解剖模型显示了提肌抬起上眼睑的作用。

entries.en: The genetic diagram marks the heterozygote with two different allele letters.
entries.zh: 遗传图用两个不同的等位基因字母标记杂合体。

entries.en: The high quality of the stitching impressed the costume designer.
entries.zh: 缝制的高品质给服装设计师留下了深刻印象。

entries.en: The engineer put forward a cheaper design for the footbridge.
entries.zh: 工程师提出了一个成本更低的人行桥设计。

entries.en: The solicitor checked the property description in the deed of trust.
entries.zh: 律师核对了信托契约中的财产描述。

entries.en: She drafted a formal business letter requesting replacement parts.
entries.zh: 她起草了一封正式业务函件，要求提供替换零件。

entries.en: The portrait shows the poet in the bloom of youth.
entries.zh: 这幅肖像展现了诗人风华正茂的模样。

entries.en: The engineer designed a maintainable machine with easily accessible components.
entries.zh: 工程师设计了一台易于维修、部件方便接触的机器。

entries.en: The carpenter cut a fibreboard panel for the cupboard's back.
entries.zh: 木匠切了一块纤维板作为橱柜背板。

entries.en: The genetics seminar included a discussion of thalassemia.
entries.zh: 遗传学研讨课讨论了地中海贫血。

entries.en: The catalog groups books by subject area rather than by author.
entries.zh: 目录按学科领域而非作者对书籍分类。

entries.en: The children regarded their coach as an authority figure.
entries.zh: 孩子们把教练视为权威人物。

entries.en: The anatomy chart marks a pressure point near the wrist.
entries.zh: 解剖图在手腕附近标出了一个压迫点。

entries.en: The sound of the train gradually died away.
entries.zh: 火车的声音渐渐消失了。

entries.en: Everyone called her a good egg after she repaired the club's roof.
entries.zh: 她修好了俱乐部屋顶，大家都说她是个好人。

entries.en: We walked around the fallen tree to reach the path.
entries.zh: 我们绕过倒下的树，走到了小路上。

entries.en: The business leader announced funding for a new training center.
entries.zh: 这位商界领袖宣布资助一个新的培训中心。

entries.en: The history class examined how Nazi propaganda invoked lebensraum to justify expansion.
entries.zh: 历史课考察了纳粹宣传如何借用“生存空间”为扩张辩护。

entries.en: The epistemologist asked what would count as evidence for that belief.
entries.zh: 认识论学家问，什么才能算作支持那个信念的证据。

entries.en: The clinic displayed an information leaflet introducing podiatry.
entries.zh: 诊所展示了一份介绍足病医学的宣传单。

entries.en: The stall did a land-office business when the festival crowds arrived.
entries.zh: 节庆人群到来后，摊位生意兴隆。

entries.en: In the story, smoke from the campfire smoked out the hidden thieves.
entries.zh: 故事中，营火的烟把躲藏的盗贼熏了出来。

entries.en: She brought a notebook and packed spare pencils as well.
entries.zh: 她带了笔记本，也装上了备用铅笔。

entries.en: The shy visitor hung back while the others entered the crowded room.
entries.zh: 其他人进入拥挤的房间时，那位害羞的访客却步不前。

entries.en: The golfer wiped mud from the club head before the next shot.
entries.zh: 高尔夫球手在下一次击球前擦掉了杆头上的泥。

entries.en: The nurse asked whether he had difficulty passing water.
entries.zh: 护士询问他是否排尿困难。

entries.en: The stacked crates pressed down on the fragile cardboard box.
entries.zh: 堆叠的板条箱压在脆弱的纸板箱上。

entries.en: The laboratory exercise used a fictional case report mentioning ketosis.
entries.zh: 实验课使用了一份提及酮症的虚构病例报告。

entries.en: The device humidifies the air around the stored wooden instruments.
entries.zh: 设备使存放的木制乐器周围的空气变得湿润。

entries.en: The documentary's diagram shows an airburst above the empty test site.
entries.zh: 纪录片的图示显示了空旷试验场上方的一次空中爆炸。

entries.en: We agreed on a six-week time frame for restoring the mural.
entries.zh: 我们商定用六周时间修复壁画。

entries.en: The prison memoir describes the silence inside the death house.
entries.zh: 这本监狱回忆录描述了死囚牢房中的寂静。

entries.en: The jazz trio played at a night club near the station.
entries.zh: 爵士三重奏在车站附近的一家夜总会演出。

entries.en: We can dispense with the introduction and begin the demonstration.
entries.zh: 我们可以省去介绍，直接开始演示。

entries.en: The government agency published maps of the protected wetlands.
entries.zh: 政府机构公布了受保护湿地的地图。

entries.en: Passengers milled about the platform after the cancellation was announced.
entries.zh: 取消通知发布后，乘客们在站台上无所适从地走来走去。

entries.en: The training room displayed a laparoscope beside a model abdomen.
entries.zh: 培训室在腹部模型旁展示了一台腹腔镜。

entries.en: The telegrapher tapped out the weather report before dawn.
entries.zh: 电报员在黎明前敲发了天气报告。

entries.en: The water-treatment diagram includes a separate demineralization stage.
entries.zh: 水处理图示包含一个单独的去矿化阶段。

entries.en: The rescued puppy became the center of attention at the picnic.
entries.zh: 那只获救的小狗成了野餐会上众人关注的焦点。

entries.en: The runners changed in the field house before warming up.
entries.zh: 跑步者在运动场更衣室换衣服，然后开始热身。

entries.en: The wonder child performed her own piano composition at the concert.
entries.zh: 这位神童在音乐会上演奏了自己创作的钢琴曲。

entries.en: He crawled on all fours beneath the low wooden platform.
entries.zh: 他手脚着地，爬过低矮的木平台下面。

entries.en: Her story struck a chord with everyone who had moved away from home.
entries.zh: 她的故事引起了所有离家者的共鸣。

entries.en: Please check over the guest list before printing the invitations.
entries.zh: 印请柬前，请仔细核对宾客名单。

entries.en: The model applies the theory of gravitation to two orbiting bodies.
entries.zh: 模型把引力理论应用于两个相互绕行的天体。

entries.en: The case notes describe a stuporous patient who responded slowly to questions.
entries.zh: 病例记录描述了一位处于昏沉状态、回答问题缓慢的患者。

entries.en: The anatomy lecture compared diagrams of lordosis and normal spinal curvature.
entries.zh: 解剖课比较了脊柱前凸与正常脊柱弯曲的图示。

entries.en: The old recipe calls for oleo instead of butter.
entries.zh: 这份旧食谱要求用人造黄油代替黄油。

entries.en: The carpenter cut away the rotten wood around the hinge.
entries.zh: 木匠切掉了铰链周围腐烂的木头。

entries.en: A cracked pane of glass rattled in the window frame.
entries.zh: 一块有裂缝的玻璃在窗框里咯咯作响。

entries.en: Add together the three totals before calculating the final average.
entries.zh: 计算最终平均数前，先把三个总数加起来。

entries.en: The radio station signed off after the midnight news.
entries.zh: 电台播完午夜新闻后停止了广播。

entries.en: The museum displayed the officer's side arm beside his uniform.
entries.zh: 博物馆把军官的佩枪和制服并列展出。

entries.en: The collector examined the watermark on the old government note.
entries.zh: 收藏家检查了那张旧政府纸币上的水印。

entries.en: Moving to the island changed their life style completely.
entries.zh: 搬到岛上彻底改变了他们的生活方式。

entries.en: The model illustrates valvular movement as fluid passes through the chamber.
entries.zh: 模型展示了液体流过腔室时的瓣膜运动。

entries.en: The seminar compared the Renaissance episteme with later systems of knowledge.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了文艺复兴时期的知识体系与后来的知识体系。

entries.en: The student identified the ilium on the pelvis model.
entries.zh: 学生在骨盆模型上辨认出了髂骨。

entries.en: The inheritance chart shows a family relationship established through adoption.
entries.zh: 继承关系图显示了一种通过收养建立的家庭关系。

entries.en: The library created a life science section for biology and related subjects.
entries.zh: 图书馆设立了生命科学区，收录生物学及相关学科书籍。

entries.en: The historian described lobbyists as a third house influencing congressional decisions.
entries.zh: 历史学家把游说者描述为影响国会决策的“第三院”。

entries.en: The director added stage business involving a misplaced hat.
entries.zh: 导演添加了围绕一顶放错位置的帽子的舞台动作。

entries.en: A man of the world, he recognized the flattering sales pitch immediately.
entries.zh: 他饱经世故，一下就识破了那套奉承的推销话术。

entries.en: A special interest from the shipping industry opposed the proposed harbor rules.
entries.zh: 航运业的一个特殊利益集团反对拟议的港口规定。

entries.en: I could barely make out the address on the rain-soaked envelope.
entries.zh: 我勉强辨认出了被雨淋湿的信封上的地址。

entries.en: The comedian played a lovable lummox who knocked over every chair.
entries.zh: 喜剧演员扮演了一个可爱的笨家伙，总把椅子撞倒。

entries.en: The policy's vindicator defended it before a skeptical committee.
entries.zh: 这项政策的辩护者在持怀疑态度的委员会面前为其辩护。

entries.en: The log groups observations by civil day, from midnight to midnight.
entries.zh: 日志按从午夜到午夜的历日对观察记录分组。

entries.en: The exhibition explores black music through recordings by African-American performers.
entries.zh: 展览通过非裔美国表演者的录音探索黑人音乐。

entries.en: The factory combines high technology with traditional hand finishing.
entries.zh: 工厂把高科技与传统手工精修结合起来。

entries.en: He hoped to live out his remaining years beside the sea.
entries.zh: 他希望在海边度过余生。

entries.en: We set out before dawn to avoid the afternoon heat.
entries.zh: 我们在黎明前出发，以避开午后的炎热。

entries.en: Watch out for the loose stones near the steps.
entries.zh: 当心台阶附近松动的石头。

entries.en: The restored theater lived up to our expectations on opening night.
entries.zh: 修复后的剧院在开幕夜达到了我们的期望。

entries.en: The monologist held the audience's attention without another performer on stage.
entries.zh: 这位独白演员独自在台上吸引住了观众。

entries.en: A brass tieback held the curtain away from the open window.
entries.zh: 一个黄铜窗帘钩把窗帘固定在敞开的窗户旁。

entries.en: The cellar's dankness had damaged the stored cardboard boxes.
entries.zh: 地窖的阴湿损坏了存放的纸板箱。

entries.en: The social worker helped the family find temporary housing.
entries.zh: 社会工作者帮助这家人找到了临时住房。

entries.en: She laughed off the embarrassing mistake and continued her speech.
entries.zh: 她对那个尴尬的错误一笑置之，继续演讲。

entries.en: The leading cyclist began to draw away on the steep hill.
entries.zh: 领先的骑手开始在陡坡上拉开距离。

entries.en: Help me pick out a durable bag for the trip.
entries.zh: 帮我挑一个结实的旅行包。

entries.en: The radio's time signal sounded before the evening news.
entries.zh: 广播的报时信号在晚间新闻前响起。

entries.en: She scraped by on occasional translation jobs while finishing her degree.
entries.zh: 攻读学位期间，她靠零星的翻译工作勉强度日。

entries.en: The volunteer dealt out sandwiches to the waiting passengers.
entries.zh: 志愿者把三明治分给等候的乘客。

entries.en: The medical illustration compares eye alignment with and without strabismus.
entries.zh: 医学插图比较了斜视与无斜视时的眼位。

entries.en: The study recorded calls between conspecific birds in neighboring territories.
entries.zh: 研究记录了相邻领地中同种鸟类之间的鸣叫。

entries.en: The photograph showed lividity around the bruised area.
entries.zh: 照片显示了瘀伤周围的青紫色。

entries.en: Everyone must pull their weight if the shelter is to open on time.
entries.zh: 避难所要按时开放，每个人都必须尽自己的一份力。

entries.en: The circuit exercise applies conservation of electricity at each junction.
entries.zh: 电路练习在每个接点应用电荷守恒。

entries.en: The retailer closed out its old stock before changing suppliers.
entries.zh: 更换供应商前，零售商清售了旧库存。

entries.en: A mother-of-pearl cloud shimmered above the dark horizon after sunset.
entries.zh: 日落后，一片珠母云在暗沉的地平线上方闪耀。

entries.en: The ship model shows how the centre of buoyancy shifts when it tilts.
entries.zh: 船模显示了船倾斜时浮心如何移动。
